description_for_human: Give your AI agent a real email address. Send and receive emails via API.
description_for_model: ClawAIMail provides email infrastructure for AI agents. Use it to create email inboxes (e.g. mybot@clawaimail.com), send emails, receive emails, search messages, and manage email threads. Supports webhooks for real-time notifications and custom domains. Authentication via API key (Bearer token with pb_ prefix). Base URL: https://api.clawaimail.com
